== Overview ==

A world that starts from zero: lower rates, a far tighter balance pass, and PvP decided by skill instead of by who stacked more. Everyone leaves the temple on the same day, at level one. This wording comes from the recorded official website metadata.

Players searching for '''Unline''' usually want the official website, client download path, rules, rates, and whether the world is still active. See:

* [https://opentibiaservers.com/unline Unline server profile]
* [https://opentibiaservers.com OpenTibiaServers.com homepage]
* [https://opentibiaservers.com/directory Full directory / filters]
